# xterm.js (vendored)

The terminal in the browser (Settings › Terminal, `terminal.js`). It is
[xterm.js](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) 5.5.0 with its fit addon
0.10.0, MIT (`LICENSE.txt`), copied unchanged from the npm packages
`@xterm/xterm@5.5.0` (`lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css`) and
`@xterm/addon-fit@0.10.0` (`lib/addon-fit.js`), without their source map
comments, so the web UI loads nothing from outside. They set
`window.Terminal` and `window.FitAddon`.

Do not edit these files; update by copying a newer release.
